guidePage.title: What is Planning Poker? A Complete Guide to Agile Estimation
guidePage.intro: Learn how Planning Poker improves agile project estimation, why it works and how to introduce it effectively in a Scrum team.
guidePage.stepsTitle: How to run Planning Poker: step by step
guidePage.finalTitle: Improve your planning with Planning Poker
guidePage.finalDescription: Bring the team together for clearer conversations, shared understanding and more reliable estimates.

landing.heroDescription: Bring your team together, vote with Fibonacci or special cards and reveal every estimate at the same time. No sign-up and no distractions.
landing.benefitsDescription: A lightweight experience for sprint planning, refinement and remote estimation.
landing.benefit1Description: See who has voted and keep the team synchronized without refreshing the page.
landing.benefit2Description: Choices remain secret until all cards are revealed simultaneously.
landing.benefit3Description: Confirm a round to save its average, distribution and votes in the room history.
landing.stepsTitle: From room creation to consensus in four steps
landing.stepsDescription: The flow keeps everyone's attention on the story being discussed — not on the tool.
landing.step1Title: Create a room and add context
landing.step1Description: Click “Create a free room”, enter your name and name the story or task for the round.
landing.step2Description: Share the link. Each person joins with their own name, without creating an account.
landing.step3Description: Choose a Fibonacci card, use ? to request more information or ☕ to suggest a break.
landing.step4Description: Compare the average and distribution, redo the round or confirm the result and start the next one.
landing.ctaDescription: Create a room, send the link and let Battle Poker handle voting and the simultaneous reveal.
landing.learnDescription: Planning Poker is a consensus-based estimation technique. Each person selects a card privately and all cards are revealed together, reducing anchoring bias.
landing.footer: Battle Poker — Free online Planning Poker.
